**Do not edit this stub.** The cross-repo source of truth is:

| Checkout | Path |
|----------|------|
| GrizzTeam / sibling layout | `symlfy-baas/RECURRING-BUG-CLASSES.md` (repo root) |
| Cloud Agent (after install) | `/symlfy-baas/RECURRING-BUG-CLASSES.md` |
